defects_identified.description: Six-hour trip in Bhubaneswar returned Ananda Bazar (Puri) and Bikalananda Kar Rasagola Hub (Salepur, Cuttack) due to ranking prioritizing interest scores over geographic locality without radius/locality constraints.
Null fares were described as 'Transit fares available at boarding', implying a specific payment location/method without verified payment evidence.
API represents days (1..7); 6 hours is mapped to 1 day but travel time between distant cities was not accounted for as infeasible.
Acceptance report stated '100% behavioral parity verified' while iOS runtime is pending macOS.
Ponytail report included unsupported claim '10x faster trip creation' not backed by measured benchmark.
